code: metadata <- expand.grid(   visit = 0:2, subject_index = 1:6,   condition = c("control", "treated"),   KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) metadata$subject <- paste(metadata$condition, metadata$subject_index, sep = "_") metadata$batch <- factor(ifelse(metadata$subject_index %% 2 == 0, "A", "B")) metadata$age <- rep(c(25, 42, 31, 56, 38, 49), each = 3, times = 2) rownames(metadata) <- paste(metadata$subject, metadata$visit, sep = "_") means <- outer(seq(40, 150, length.out = 12), rep(1, nrow(metadata))) means[1, ] <- means[1, ] * ifelse(metadata$condition == "treated", 2, 1) means[2, ] <- means[2, ] * exp(   0.3 * metadata$visit * (metadata$condition == "treated") ) counts <- matrix(   rnbinom(length(means), mu = as.vector(means), size = 20),   nrow = nrow(means),   dimnames = list(paste0("taxon_", seq_len(nrow(means))), rownames(metadata)) ) taxonomy <- cbind(   Genus = paste0("Genus_", seq_len(nrow(counts))),   Species = paste0("Species_", seq_len(nrow(counts))) ) rownames(taxonomy) <- rownames(counts) longitudinal_phy <- phyloseq::phyloseq(   phyloseq::otu_table(counts, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),   phyloseq::tax_table(taxonomy),   phyloseq::sample_data(metadata) ) phy <- phyloseq::prune_samples(metadata$visit == 0, longitudinal_phy)

text: dar provides recipe-based differential abundance workflows microbiome data. accepts phyloseq TreeSummarizedExperiment inputs combines preprocessing, quality control multiple statistical methods common, pipeable interface. centralized model required DA execution. defines covariates, contrasts, reference levels taxonomic level analysis. code: my_function <- function(data, var, ...) {   data %>%     group_by(...) %>%     summarise(mean = mean({{ var }})) } my_function <- function(data, var, ...) {   # Defuse   var <- enquo(var)   dots <- enquos(...)    # Inject   data %>%     group_by(!!!dots) %>%     summarise(mean = mean(!!var)) } my_var <- "disp" mtcars %>% summarise(mean = mean(.data[[my_var]])) my_function <- function(data, var, suffix = "foo") {   # Use `{{` to tunnel function arguments and the usual glue   # operator `{` to interpolate plain strings.   data %>%     summarise("{{ var }}_mean_{suffix}" := mean({{ var }})) } my_function <- function(data, var, suffix = "foo") {   var <- enquo(var)   prefix <- as_label(var)   data %>%     summarise("{prefix}_mean_{suffix}" := mean(!!var)) }
